messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for route /v1/chat/completions (interactive-mistral) — p99=2.83s, baseline=1.1s, triggered 3x in 5m
lee (oncall): seeing it too, also a small bump on embeddings read path. no error rate increase yet. paging per runbook. :phone:
lee (oncall): quick context — traffic shifted ~20% to us-east due to regional weights, might be headroom on the pool but p99 climbed fast after a canary rollout yesterday.
morgan (eng-platform): @lee (oncall) good catch. I saw the canary metrics — the canary model variant has slightly longer kv-cache warm start for long histories. that lines up.
ruth (eng-sre): setting temp squelch on pager for this route while we triage. we should avoid noisy p99 pings for the next 15m while we confirm impact.
lee (oncall): ops-bot, please add note to incident timeline: "p99 spike correlated with canary variant warm-start; no customer errors observed; mitigation = routing rollback candidate"
ops-bot: timeline entry added.
lee (oncall): customer-impact check: @aaron (product) do we have any active paying customers on the interactive-mistral route that would have noticed elevated latency?
aaron (product): quick grep — two mid-market customers use that route; they reported slight slowdowns in console but no API errors. CS already opened a ticket and put a banner. will sync after this thread.
morgan (eng-platform): propose temporary mitigation: route traffic away from canary variant -> fallback to stable-mistral (same model family, quantized) until KV-cache patch lands. this keeps p95 stable. can we do a fast route rule?
ruth (eng-sre): yes. I can flip route weight in the routing controller. planned change: set interactive-mistral canary weight 0 -> 0. I will do canary->0 in 30s unless objections.
hana (devex): FYI we should note this in the docs/rollouts checklist: add p99 short-history warmup as a canary metric. we forgot that in last rollout. :memo:
lee (oncall): go ahead, ruth. also please bump p99 alert threshold from 2.0s -> 3.0s for interactive-mistral while we confirm warm-start behavior, and create a short-lived dashboard showing per-model p95/p99 by route. mark as temporary with TTL 6h.
morgan (eng-platform): quick config snippet for the alert change (terraform):
```hcl
resource "alert_rule" "interactive_mistral_p99" {
  route = "/v1/chat/completions"
  model_group = "interactive-mistral"
  aggregation = "p99"
  threshold_seconds = 3.0 # temp relax from 2.0
  duration = "5m"
  tags = ["temp-relax", "post-incident"]
}
```
ruth (eng-sre): applying routing rollback now. will post deploy job id.
ops-bot: deploy job started: job_id=deploy-77821, target=router-v2, change=set-canary-weight-0
ops-bot: deploy job success: job_id=deploy-77821, finished in 18s
ruth (eng-sre): canary weight set to 0. observing metrics... p99 down to 1.15s across the route in the last sample window. :tada:
lee (oncall): nice. thanks. keep p99 alert threshold relaxed for now but add monitoring to auto-escalate if p95 increases >20% over baseline.
morgan (eng-platform): creating dashboard now. will include panels: per-model p95, p99, median, throughput, kv-cache hit ratio, and recent rollout tags. putting as temporary dashboard id=dash-9902-ephemeral
hana (devex): can you also add a small eval that runs 50 short-history and 50 long-history prompts to measure warm-start delta? we need a reproducible check before re-enabling canary.
morgan (eng-platform): will add. plan: run eval daily until next rollout.
aaron (product): customer comms: I'll update the banner and send targeted note to the two customers. say 'transient latency' and that we rolled back canary.
lee (oncall): handoff note — I'm ending my pager window in 20m. morgan, please take over monitoring and own follow-ups for the next 8h (especially dashboard and eval). leave a short doc in incidents/ if anything changes.
morgan (eng-platform): taking over. I'll tag this thread and create the incident stub: "interactive-mistral p99 warm-start spike — rollback -> monitoring"
ops-bot: incident stub created: incident-2409876543-interactive-warmstart
ruth (eng-sre): follow-ups (ACTION items):
- Restore canary only after warm-start patch and automated long-history evals show parity (owner: morgan)
- Add canary checklist item for p99 warm-up and kv-cache hit ratio (owner: hana)
- Add permanent per-model per-route p95/p99 dashboard with alert baselines (owner: morgan + ruth)
- Revisit alert thresholds: consider p95 soft alert and p99 hard alert with noise gating (owner: eng-platform)
lee (oncall): leaving final note: no customer-facing errors, rollback effective. keeping p99 threshold relaxed for 6h. reopen if any error rates or p95 regression. passing to @morgan (eng-platform). :white_check_mark:
morgan (eng-platform): ack. will post follow-up doc and ping @ruth and @hana when dashboard + eval are ready.
ops-bot: thread archived to incident-2409876543 folder.
